subtitle.en: Stills from the new trailer we are putting together, using non-final footage.
subtitle.zh: 新预告片的几张静帧——用的还是非最终素材。

translator.note: 原文 3 张图排在同一行，保留为一个占位段落；图片链接指向原文上传的最大尺寸原图。

blocks.en: This week we have been working on a new trailer that we hope to release before too long.
blocks.zh: 这周我们一直在做一部新预告片，希望不用太久就能放出来。

blocks.en: It will not only show the game in a further state of visual development than the previous trailer (which is two and a half years old now -- wow!), it'll also show lots of scenes you probably haven't seen before.
blocks.zh: 它不仅会展示比上一部预告片（那已经是两年半前的东西了——哇！）在美术开发上更进一步的状态，还会展示很多你大概没见过的场景。

blocks.en: The trailer isn't done yet, but here are a few stills:
blocks.zh: 预告片还没做完，但这里先放几张静帧：

blocks.en: Ignore the debug text in the upper-right (including the frame rate; these were taken on a monitor that's locked at 30Hz; the game runs much faster on higher-end PCs.) Also, the actual trailer will be produced at much sharper image quality and higher resolution. These are just snippets of the non-final footage we are using to figure out the composition and flow of the trailer.
blocks.zh: 请忽略右上角的调试文字（包括帧率；这些是在一台锁在 30Hz 的显示器上截的，游戏在高配 PC 上跑起来快得多。）另外，真正的预告片会以清晰得多的画质和更高的分辨率制作。这些只是我们用来琢磨预告片构图与节奏的非最终素材片段。
